idea-plugin.name: Tri-Model AI Orchestrator
idea-plugin.description:
Orchestrate Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini together inside your IDE to write, analyze, review, and refine code under one unified workflow.

Key Capabilities:
  • 5 Multi-Model Orchestration Modes: Role Pipeline (Architect → Coder → Reviewer → Finalizer), Iterative Write-Review-Fix Loop (Coder ↔ Dual Reviewers), Parallel Council & Cross-Critique Consensus, Tri-Model Deep Code Audit, and Parallel Side-by-Side Comparison.
  • Flexible Role Assignment: Assign Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini to any engineering role (Architect, Coder, Reviewer, Chair/Synthesizer).
  • Direct Official APIs or Local CLIs: Connect directly to Anthropic Messages API, OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions API, and Google Gemini Interactions/generateContent API with credentials stored securely in JetBrains PasswordSafe — or invoke locally installed CLIs (claude, codex, gemini).
  • Deep IDE Integration: Attaches active files, code selections, extra workspace files, and live IDE inspection diagnostics; previews proposed edits in the native Diff Viewer; applies single- or multi-file changes atomically with full Undo support.

Privacy & Data Handling:

Prompts, explicitly attached code snippets, and optional editor diagnostics are transmitted directly from your machine to the AI provider endpoints or local CLIs you configure. This extension operates no intermediary backend servers and collects zero telemetry or analytics. API keys are stored exclusively in JetBrains PasswordSafe (OS Keychain). See our Privacy Policy and Security Policy.

Independent open-source software licensed under Apache 2.0. Not affiliated with or endorsed by JetBrains, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google.
